programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: A mysterious well filled with bones reveals a strange practice in ancient Persia; archaeologists digging in Mongolia uncover a 2000-year-old textile that holds the key to the mystery of an elixir; in Sichuan, China, hanging coffins are discovered.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Human remains high in the Ecuadorian Andes; in Norway, an archaeology student unearths metal artifacts; a strange, earthquake-like event in Canada; a Viking longhouse with a unique history in Greenland.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: Peat diggers find a head near Silkeborg, Denmark and authorities investigate whether it is related to the missing boy; the police discover that the body is much older than the missing person and call the museum to investigate.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The journey begins and the truth they seek may reside in author Farley Mowat's journals and Joe's meeting with a modern-day artist. So begins the quest for the lost Vikings.
